project_name: Portal Orang Tua Asuh (Foster Parent Portal)

theme.name: Islamic Modern Luxury (Emerald & Royal Gold)
theme.aesthetic: Calm, dignified, trustworthy, warm, philanthropic Islamic-modern with generous whitespace and refined tactile accents. No excessive decorative patterns or cheap gradients.

typography.font_strategy: Fraunces / Playfair Display / Outfit paired with Plus Jakarta Sans & IBM Plex Sans. Never use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.

login_page.layout: Split screen or centered luxury card on subtle emerald geometric motif background
elements: Brand badge with gold crescent/sparkle emblem
Portal Admin Orang Tua Asuh title with Islamic greeting (Bismillah)
Email / Username and Password inputs with luxury focus rings
Remember me checkbox & Bantuan Kontak Admin link
Sign in primary CTA in #0B3D2E with subtle gold shimmer border
Security assurance note: 'Sistem Terenkripsi & Terverifikasi Pengelola'

widgets: Hero welcome banner with current Hijri & Gregorian date in Indonesian
4 Metric Cards: Total Orang Tua Asuh Aktif, Total Anak Asuh Binaan, Total Donasi Bulan Ini (IDR), Rasio Laporan Terlapor (%)
Status Distribution Orang Tua Asuh (Rutin, Tidak Rutin, Insidentil, Tidak Aktif) with visual badges and count bars
Laporan Bulanan Status Monitor (Widget ringkasan bulan berjalan + tombol aksi cepat unduh/kelola)
Aktivitas Terkini (Donasi masuk terbaru, capaian/perkembangan anak asuh terinput)
Quick Action Drawer/Buttons: Tambah Donasi, Input Capaian, Tambah Orang Tua Asuh, Buat Relasi

list_view.filters: Search nama/kontak, status commitment (Rutin/Tidak Rutin/Insidentil/Tidak Aktif), sorting
list_view.presentation: Modern card grid with status badge, jumlah anak asuh terhubung, total riwayat donasi, WhatsApp direct button, dan Salin Tautan Portal tombol cepat

detail_view.header: Nama lengkap, No WA, Alamat/Kota, Komitmen Donasi Bulanan, Status Badge, Token Portal Private Link with One-Click Copy & Preview

tabs.label: Ringkasan & Profil
tabs.content: Info personal, kontak, preferensi laporan, catatan khusus

tabs.label: Anak Asuh Binaan
tabs.content: Daftar anak asuh yang didanai (Many-to-Many cards) + aksi kelola relasi

tabs.label: Perkembangan Anak
tabs.content: Feed capaian/hafalan/rapor khusus anak binaan orang tua asuh ini

tabs.label: Riwayat Donasi
tabs.content: Catatan donasi lembaga (Tanggal, Metode, Nominal, Bukti Transfer)

list_view.filters: Search nama/NIM, angkatan, jenjang pendidikan (SD/SMP/SMA/Kuliah), status binaan
list_view.presentation: Card grid with avatar photo, NIM, angkatan badge, nama sekolah/pesantren, jumlah Orang Tua Asuh terkait

detail_view.header: Foto resmi, Nama Lengkap, NIM, Angkatan, Jenjang, Status Aktif, Wali/Pembina
detail_view.profile_card: Biodata, latar belakang keluarga, cita-cita, tanggal masuk, prestasi unggulan
detail_view.related_foster_parents: Many-to-Many junction cards showing all Orang Tua Asuh funding this child with status and since date
detail_view.development_timeline: Timeline capaian berkala (Akademik, Al-Qur'an/Hafalan, Karakter, Kesehatan) with filter by semester

relation_manager_module.concept: Junction table manager to connect multiple foster parents with multiple children (Many-to-Many)
features: Interactive pairing modal / form: Pilih Orang Tua Asuh -> Pilih Anak Asuh -> Tanggal Mulai Relasi -> Catatan Penugasan
Matrix view & searchable linked pairs list with unassign/reassign actions and bulk management

donasi_module.strict_rule: Donasi is recorded for Orang Tua Asuh only and NEVER directly linked to a specific child (Institutional pooled fund rule)
features: Filter by date range, Orang Tua Asuh, metode pembayaran (Transfer Bank, QRIS, Tunai, Auto-Debit), status verifikasi
Summary stats: Total Terkumpul Periode Ini, Rata-rata Donasi, Donatur Baru
Modal Form Catat Donasi: Pilih Orang Tua Asuh, Tanggal, Nominal (Rupiah auto-format), Bank Tujuan, Catatan/Doa, Upload/Link Bukti

perkembangan_module.concept: Accordion-based child progress logging by Child, Semester, and Category
features: Accordion grouped by Anak Asuh and Semester
Form input capaian baru with date, category badge, score/level, narrative description, photo attachment
Status visibility toggle (Publikasikan ke Portal Orang Tua Asuh)

laporan_bulanan_module.concept: Matrix checklist & distribution tracker for monthly foster-parent reports
features: Status filter: Semua, Terlapor (Sent/Ready), Belum Terlapor
Matrix table/cards showing each Orang Tua Asuh, list of their assigned children, report preparation status, WA send shortcut with pre-filled message + token link, and mark as completed timestamp

public_foster_portal.concept: Exclusive private link for foster parents (NO LOGIN required) — mobile first and emotionally heartwarming

sections.name: Hero Greeting
sections.content: Assalamu'alaikum Warahmatullahi Wabarakatuh, Bapak/Ibu [Nama Orang Tua Asuh]. 'Jazakumullah Khairan atas kebaikan dan ketulusan Anda menjadi Orang Tua Asuh bagi generasi penerus umat.'

sections.name: Ringkasan Binaan
sections.content: 4 Key Metrics: Anak Binaan Aktif, Total Capaian Terdata, Status Laporan Bulan Berjalan, Masa Menjadi Orang Tua Asuh

sections.name: Daftar Anak Asuh
sections.content: Interactive Child Cards with high quality photo, school/grade, dream/cita-cita, hobby, and button 'Lihat Capaian & Profil Lengkap'

sections.name: Detail Perkembangan & Linimasa
sections.content: Filterable timeline by child & category (Tahfidz, Akademik, Karakter) with rich cards showing progress, photo activities, and teacher/mentor notes

sections.name: Riwayat Donasi Kebaikan
sections.content: Clean chronological list showing Tanggal, Bulan Donasi, Nominal (IDR), Status Diterima. STRICT: Institutional donation ledger only (no per-child allocation)

sections.name: Status Laporan Bulanan
sections.content: Interactive calendar/monthly cards showing report publication status with PDF download/view action

sections.name: Hubungi Pengurus / Doa
sections.content: Floating / footer action to send doa to foster child or contact institution care coordinator via WhatsApp

interaction_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use Sonner with emerald green success style for save/copy/publish actions, and amber for warnings
interaction_guidelines.empty_states: Warm illustrated empty states with Islamic aesthetic and friendly call-to-action in Bahasa Indonesia
interaction_guidelines.loading_states: Subtle skeleton pulse in tinted green/gold instead of harsh gray rectangles

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete application with React 19, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, Framer Motion, and Radix UI / Sonner primitives.
Ensure 100% Bahasa Indonesia across all UI texts, notifications, forms, and placeholders.
Provide rich realistic mock data with Indonesian names, pesantren/school names, realistic rupiah donations, and authentic progress records (Tahfidz juz 29-30, ranking sekolah, etc.).
Ensure the public portal at /portal/:token works seamlessly without any login barrier, while admin routes are protected or accessible via login at /login.
Adhere strictly to the Dark Green (#0B3D2E, #123F32) and Gold (#C9A227) theme with clean light content background.
Donasi records MUST NOT link to a specific child; they belong strictly to Orang Tua Asuh.
Add data-testid attributes to all key buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and status badges.
